div.div: سَرَابٌ أَسْيَعُ A mirage [running upon the surface of the ground, (see 1,) and] in a state of commotion: (S, * TA:) or, as some say, [in a state of exceeding commotion; for] the form of the epithet in this case denotes مُفَاضَلَة. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
